concurrency: Concurrent PM/recording work was not stopped. Every two seconds the background log records executable names and observed ps CPU/load; snapshots do not attribute individual stalls. Profiling itself includes this monitoring overhead.

prospective_design.run_order: rates in listed ascending order; workloads idle,single,12voice_fm,pending_retired_cv127,pending_silent_cv127; each audio block rotates lane call order by (block+caseIndex)modlaneCount
prospective_design.pending_scope: Hold source1 CV note127 without keyoff. Natural variant: carrier D2R31,D1R0,D1L0. Silent variant: carrier TL127. Both must have zero active voices after2s preroll; request opposite law then measure deferred ownership scan. Release key after timing and require eventual switch. Compare timings only with own ordinary idle, not a falsely equivalent baseline workload.

prospective_design.timing: For each process64 call: wallMONOTONIC start,threadCPU start,process,threadCPU end,wall end. No timer-overhead subtraction. prospective_design.concurrent_load: Do not stop existing PM, recording benchmark or other workloads. Capture executable-name ps CPU/load snapshots every2s. Record but do not infer causal attribution or describe this as Reason host CPU.
prospective_design.resources: Report sizeofEngine+OutputBus, maxRSS/contextswitches, render allocations; fullwrapper prior bound memory receipt only, no wrapper construct in timer.

concurrency_observations.limitations: Snapshot CPU is the operating system ps report, not per-block attribution. Generic Python executable names alone cannot identify PM versus another benchmark. External task coordination can establish task presence separately. No background process was stopped.

resource_scope: The timing executable links both namespaces and keeps two/three instances alive for pairing. Its RSS is not single-instance RSS. Engine and OutputBus sizeof are measured here; full wrapper sizeof is cited from the bound independent/owner receipts, not remeasured. C++ new/new[] calls are counted within measured process blocks; these hooks are not a general operating-system allocation profiler.
interpretation: Mean-time sanity only passes. Zero wall-deadline gate fails and all failures are retained. This is not a realtime/Reason-host acceptance result, speedup result, or optimization. Current production was unchanged. The maximum output peak reaches1 under the existing protection: do not call the fixture unclipped.
tracking_scope: New research MD/JSON only; raw per-block CSV and source snapshots stay ignored. No production or candidate source edits.

output_hash_scope.actual_algorithm: FNV-1a-style xor/multiply over little-endian float32 bit bytes, custom initial seed1469598103934665603 and multiplier1099511628211 modulo2^64.
output_hash_scope.note: The frozen field name is retained; this is not the standard FNV64 offset basis or a cryptographic digest. Equality supplements the prior exact byte proof.
